'''Zack Workman''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[1999 Dagobah Regionals]] on 25 September 1999 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]], according to Mike Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d55">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-29-dagobah-regional-9-25-99-tallahassee-fld55/ dagobah-regional-9-25-99-tallahassee-fl], DeckTech (Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald, 29 September 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-29-dagobah-regional-9-25-99-tallahassee-fld55/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
